nodes.label: Thin Pi Mirror Principle
nodes.rationale: The Pi role file is intentionally thin: it exists only so Pi can expose the same role entry point without redefining domain behavior. The Claude role file is the canonical role contract and the Claude skill file the canonical reasoning contract; adding Pi-specific business logic or alternate output rules would fork the domain semantics across two runtimes.

nodes.label: CodeGraph-Before-Filesystem Ordering Rule
nodes.rationale: Hard ordering rule for structural/codebase questions: resolve the project root, check for .codegraph/, lazy-initialize when missing, then query via codegraph_explore or the read-only upstream CLI. A missing .codegraph/ is the trigger to initialize, not a reason to skip CodeGraph; broad Read/Glob/Grep exploration before the check is explicitly discouraged. Worktrees must live under the user's home (never /tmp) and each needs its own index because roots and checked-out bytes differ.
